channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Michelle não vai à convenção do PL que oficializará Flávio como candidato
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will not attend the PL convention that will formally nominate Flávio Bolsonaro as presidential candidate, due to the need to care for her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest in Brasília. Her inner circle states that traveling poses a logistical risk, as it would leave the former president alone. The event takes place this Saturday at Arena Mercado Livre Pacaembu in São Paulo, amid rising family tensions, including disputes with Flávio’s stepmother and controversies over funding for the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Tarifaço deixa de ser disputa entre governos e vira preocupação com o bolso, aponta estudo
item.description: The U.S. tariff hike is no longer seen merely as a diplomatic clash but as a direct threat to voters’ cost of living, according to the Democracia em Xeque Narrative Panel. Concerns over rising prices now shape evaluations of candidates like Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, focusing on their ability to prevent economic losses. Voters favor negotiation as a first resort and view retaliation as a last option, approving the Brazil Sovereign program but deeming it inadequate.

item.title: O alerta de Celso de Mello contra a retórica de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre as urnas
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Celso de Mello criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for spreading false claims about electronic voting machines, stressing that democratic criticism must be based on verifiable evidence, not mere insinuations. He warned that undermining election integrity without serious proof erodes public trust in democratic institutions.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza inquérito sobre repasses de Vorcaro para ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça authorized an investigation into Daniel Vorcaro's funding of the film 'Dark Horse', about former President Jair Bolsonaro, following a request from the Federal Police and a favorable opinion from the PGR. The funds were negotiated by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with Vorcaro committing to R$134 million but delivering only R$61 million. Mendonça also rejected two requests to investigate the matter, including one from federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT), while Minister Flávio Dino opened an inquiry into possible parliamentary amendments directed to the film's production company.

item.title: Mendonça abre investigação, que envolve Flávio Bolsonaro, sobre repasses ao filme Dark Horse
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized a Federal Police investigation into R$134 million in donations from former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, linked to financing the film Dark Horse about Jair Bolsonaro’s life. The request came from the Federal Police and Congressman Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), based on seized communications, and is connected to the Banco Master fraud probe.

item.title: Seis enigmas eleitorais que ainda precisam ser desvendados em meio às convenções
item.description: Brazil's 2026 party conventions are underway, but key decisions regarding vice-presidential picks, strategic alliances, and Senate compositions remain unresolved — especially for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign, which has yet to secure national backing from PP, Republicanos, or other Centrão parties. Former minister Tereza Cristina declined the vice-presidential offer, and PP's neutrality coupled with frustration within Republicanos heightens uncertainty. Meanwhile, Michelle Bolsonaro remains well-positioned in polls but has stayed discreet following a leaked video. The final deadline for definitions is August 5.

item.title: Coordenador de pré-campanha nega que Flávio esteja tentando imprimir 'estilo Jair' após desgastes
item.description: The coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, Senator Rogério Marinho, denied that the pre-candidate is adopting a 'Jair style' by speaking more aggressively, stating that recent remarks stem from natural indignation over reports of allegedly receiving R$ 500,000 for legal services tied to Daniel Vorcaro. Marinho said Flávio denied wrongdoing and criticized the selective use of state machinery against political opponents, while also seeking to overturn the PP-União federation's neutrality in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza inquérito no STF para investigar financiamento de Vorcaro a Dark Horse, filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized a PF inquiry into alleged misuse of funds meant to finance 'Dark Horse', a film about Jair Bolsonaro, with suspicions that part of the money was used to support Eduardo Bolsonaro’s stay in the U.S. The investigation stems from messages where Flávio Bolsonaro requested funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro, and was backed by the PGR, which found sufficient grounds for a formal probe.

item.title: Palpite Corinthians x Remo - Brasileirão - 23/07/26
item.description: Corinthians faces Remo in the 19th round of the Brasileirão on July 23 at 7:30 PM Brasília time at Neo Química Arena. Corinthians are favored to win despite their recent struggles in home games, while Remo comes in strong form with four wins in their last six matches. The article evaluates Asian handicap odds (Corinthians -1 at 1.85, Remo +1 at 2.00) and the 'both teams to score' market (yes at 2.05, no at 1.70), noting risks from Remo’s attacking form and Corinthians’ tendency to concede goals even when winning at home.

item.title: Corinthians x Remo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Corinthians and Remo face off this Thursday (23) at 7:30 PM Brasília time in the 19th round of the Brasileirão Série A at Neo Química Arena. Corinthians, 13th with 24 points, aim to climb the table after a comeback win over Grêmio, while Remo, 19th with 18 points, need a win to escape the relegation zone. The match will be broadcast on Sportv and Premiere, with projected lineups released.

item.title: Governo Trump rebate fala de Lula e diz se interessar pela integridade do processo eleitoral no Brasil
item.description: Lula responded to remarks by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, saying that if Rubio wishes to support Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, 'let him come', as 'we will defeat everyone in defense of democracy'. The Trump administration indirectly rebutted, stating its longstanding interest in freedom of expression and electoral integrity in Brazil, without naming individuals. Lula also accused Bolsonaro allies of being 'traitors of the homeland' for seeking foreign pressure against Brazil.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': Mendonça autoriza abertura de investigação da PF sobre repasses para cinebiografia de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized a Federal Police investigation into R$61 million in transfers from Daniel Vorcaro to fund the Bolsonaro biopic 'Dark Horse'. The funds were allegedly requested by Flávio Bolsonaro and routed through a company tied to Master Bank fraud schemes. Investigators are examining whether the money was exchanged for political favors.

item.title: IR 2026: Receita abre consulta ao 3º lote de restituição nesta 5ª
item.description: The Federal Revenue Service opened consultation for the third installment of the 2026 Individual Income Tax refund on Thursday, June 23, with payment scheduled for July 31. No data on beneficiaries or total amount was released due to the Electoral Grace Period, which restricts disclosures to avoid challenges at the TSE. The second batch, paid in June, was the largest in history, benefiting 9.5 million people and injecting R$16 billion into the economy.

item.title: Sandro Avelar diz que será candidato a deputado e minimiza possível disputa ao Senado
item.description: Sandro Avelar, former Public Security Secretary of the Federal District, stated he is organizing his candidacy for federal deputy, with confirmation expected on August 2. He downplayed the possibility of running for Senate, despite being considered by União Brasil, emphasizing that such a decision would require party leadership approval and coordination with the PP and allied parties.

item.title: Fiat celebra “história italiana de sucesso” nos 50 anos de Brasil
item.description: Fiat celebrates 50 years of operations in Brazil, highlighting the Betim plant as a milestone since 1976. Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa confirmed a R$ 30 billion investment through 2030 in a meeting with President Lula, reaffirming the company's commitment to local production and innovation, including a new model launch per year.

item.title: Aposta de Flávio para o governo, Cleitinho não vai à convenção do Republicanos em Minas Gerais
item.description: Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos-MG), backed by Flávio Bolsonaro as the PL’s key bet for a competitive gubernatorial run in Minas Gerais, will not attend the party’s convention on July 25 and is expected to finalize his candidacy only after the August 15 registration deadline. Despite leading in polls for the Tiradentes Palace, he is delaying his decision to 'keep people crazy,' citing the need to study the state’s fiscal challenges, including tax revenue, corporate exemptions, and the R$135 billion loss from the Kandir Law.

item.title: Valdemar ouve queixa da mulher por veto de Michelle a candidata do PL em SP: ‘Ordem da princesa derruba todo mundo’
item.description: Dana Costa, wife of PL president Valdemar Costa Neto, complained that Michelle Bolsonaro vetoed Aninha Ferreira’s candidacy for federal deputy in São Paulo, claiming it would split votes with Rosana Valle, an ally of the former first lady. Dana urged her husband to intervene, stating that 'a princess’s order knocks everyone down'. The conflict highlights internal PL tensions, particularly regarding Michelle’s opposition to supporting Ciro Gomes in Ceará and her estrangement from Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign.

item.title: André Mendonça autoriza investigação da PF sobre repasses a filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to open an investigation into financial transfers related to the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the life of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The decision, made on July 23, 2026, stems from suspicions of misuse of public funds or irregularities in fundraising for the movie's production.

item.title: Caso das notas fiscais reacende temor no PL de novos capítulos da relação entre Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: The disclosure that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's law firm received R$ 500,000 from a company linked to Banco Master resources has reignited concerns within the PL about new developments in Flávio's relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro. Despite claims of legality, party leaders believe the episode prolongs a crisis they sought to move past, fueling distrust and giving opponents ammunition. The greater fear is that further revelations could emerge during the campaign, undermining efforts to portray the matter as closed.

item.title: Governo Lula acelera busca por novos mercados e acordos para reduzir peso do tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government has accelerated efforts to diversify Brazil’s export markets and negotiate new trade agreements to reduce reliance on the United States amid a 25% tariff and the threat of an additional 12.5% surcharge. President Lula stated Brazil will not 'cry' over lost sales but will actively seek new buyers, while Minister Márcio Elias Rosa noted that 73% of Brazilian firms exporting to the U.S. have already accessed other markets since last year. ApexBrasil is preparing a commercial promotion plan for August, featuring international events and domestic outreach to connect Brazilian exporters with global buyers.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro emula viral sobre Neymar e publica vídeo de IA com faixa presidencial
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, shared an AI-generated video on social media showing multiple versions of himself, including one wearing the presidential sash. The post was published on Wednesday (22) and sparked online discussion, leveraging a viral format previously associated with Neymar. The video is part of his digital communication strategy for the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: A situação de Flávio Bolsonaro no acordo entre PL e Ciro Gomes no Ceará, segundo André Fernandes
item.description: The president of the PL in Ceará, federal deputy André Fernandes, stated that the agreement between the party and pre-candidate Ciro Gomes (PSDB) does not include support from the tucano for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy. The alliance aims to defeat Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) in the state, intensifying an internal crisis within Bolsonarism, with public criticism from Michelle Bolsonaro. Polls show Elmano leading with 44% in the first round and 47% in the second, against 45% for Ciro, in a technical tie.

item.title: Petista pede à PF investigação sobre relação de Flávio com empresas de Vorcaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) requested the Federal Police to investigate the alleged relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and shell companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The request followed a Metrópoles report revealing possible ties between the senator and companies suspected of illegal practices.

item.title: No Brasil, deputado italiano que denunciou paradeiro de Zambelli diz que ela sumiu
item.description: Italian deputy Angelo Bonelli states that Carla Zambelli is currently missing and possibly awaiting the Brazilian presidential elections in October, hoping a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro could lead to an amnesty. He criticized her evasion of justice, emphasizing her public responsibility as an elected parliamentarian. Bonelli noted Zambelli’s last public appearance was at an evangelical gathering in Rome, where she prayed for Jair Bolsonaro and those convicted in the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Moraes mantém a cassação do mandato de Arthur do Val, o ‘Mamãe Falei’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes rejected a petition by former state deputy Arthur do Val ('Mamãe Falei') seeking to annul the cassation of his mandate by the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, calling the request 'manifestly inadmissible'. Do Val had claimed violations of due process, contradiction, and broad defense, but Moraes found no evidence of STF overreach. The cassation stemmed from 2022 audio leaks in which he said Ukrainian women 'were easy because they were poor'.

item.title: PL aprova apoio a Ciro Gomes após racha entre Flávio e Michelle, e candidato no CE comemora aliança
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) officially endorsed Ciro Gomes’ (PSDB) candidacy for governor of Ceará after an internal rift between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro. Ciro welcomed the alliance as a necessary step to overcome political differences amid rising violence, corruption, and state abandonment over the past 12 years. He praised local PL leaders André Fernandes and Alcides Fernandes — the latter expected to be his Senate running mate — and criticized Governor Elmano de Freitas’ (PT) administration.

item.title: Crusoé: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro pode advogar?
item.description: The revelation that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) law firm issued a 500,000-reais invoice to a company linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro raised concerns about the compatibility of holding public office while practicing law. Although Brazilian law permits senators to continue working as lawyers during their mandate, the case has sparked debate over potential conflicts of interest and the possible use of political influence for private financial gain.

item.title: Flávio rebate reportagem sobre notas emitidas para empresas do Master
item.description: The law office of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro issued three invoices totaling 1.5 million Brazilian reais to companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master. Two invoices were canceled, while one remains active without a cancellation record. Bolsonaro rebutted the report, stating the invoices were for legitimate legal advisory services.

item.title: Lula x Bolsonaro: como estava a disputa presidencial na Quaest de julho de 2022
item.description: In July 2026, Lula maintains leadership in Quaest polls with 40% in the first round, against 28% for Flávio Bolsonaro, reducing the lead from 14 to 12 points compared to 2022. In the runoff simulation, the gap narrows from 19 to 8 points, with Lula at 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 37%.

item.title: PL prepara plano B em Minas e busca ex-secretário de Zema para palanque de Flávio em meio à indefinição de Cleitinho
item.description: The PL in Minas Gerais is structuring a plan B for Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral slate amid Cleitinho Azevedo's indecision about running for state governor. The party has opened negotiations with former Romeu Zema Chief of Staff Marcelo Aro (PP) as an alternative, while still treating Cleitinho as the priority. Aro's potential candidacy, contingent solely on Cleitinho's withdrawal, could reshape the right-wing race in the state, increase pressure on Governor Mateus Simões, and bring the PL closer to the União-PP federation.

item.title: Pedir apoio internacional à democracia é legítimo; pressionar instituições, não
item.description: The article argues that seeking international support to strengthen Brazilian democracy is legitimate, but pressuring foreign governments to impose sanctions or undermine democratic institutions is illegal. The distinction lies in the intent: affirming electoral integrity versus coercing authorities through hostile actions. The STF's June 2026 ruling confirms the illegality of far-right efforts to mobilize the U.S. government against the Brazilian judiciary.

item.title: Retrospectiva: deputados aprovaram repasse de parte da arrecadação com bets para a Polícia Federal
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved MP 1348/26, allocating up to 3% of fixed-odds betting (bets) tax revenue to the Funapol fund of the Federal Police to cover health assistance for officers, with a phased rollout: 1% in 2026, 2% in 2027, and 3% from 2028 onward. The bill also authorizes up to R$200 million in 2026 from free Treasury resources and removes the 50% cap on fund usage for health indemnities and extraordinary activity payments. It has passed the Senate and awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: A derrota de Arthur do Val em tentativa de voltar à política
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied Arthur do Val's request to overturn his 2022 mandate cassation by the São Paulo Legislative Assembly (Alesp), following a controversial audio in which he called Ukrainian women 'easy'. Arthur claimed due process violations, but Moraes ruled the petition inappropriate, as it sought to revisit a decision rather than enforce one. The cassation renders him ineligible until 2030, blocking his candidacy in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Nota fiscal liga Flávio Bolsonaro a empresário que recebeu repasses do Master: o que se sabe sobre o caso
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) received R$ 500 thousand from an accounting firm linked to businessman Rogério Lourenço Novo, who also leads Copenhagen, a consultancy that received R$ 57.9 million from Banco Master between 2024 and 2025. He also issued two canceled invoices totaling R$ 1 million to Copenhagen, claiming the work was never completed. Flávio denies any illegal ties to Master and says the allegations are attempts to falsely associate his name with the bank.

item.title: Após tarifaço e caso das urnas, Caiado muda estratégia e passa a mirar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) shifted his pre-campaign strategy to directly target Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) following the senator’s controversies over U.S. tariffs and unsubstantiated claims about Brazil’s electronic voting system. Caiado aims to position himself as the more viable conservative alternative, criticizing Flávio’s focus on election conspiracy theories instead of economic priorities like soybean exports and foreign investment.

item.title: PL não tem cedido a nossos pedidos de aliança, diz chefe do Republicanos sobre apoio a Flávio
item.description: The president of the Republicans party, federal deputy Marcos Pereira, stated that the party has not conceded to alliance requests to support Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign, conditioning support on an agreement in Mato Grosso and Roraima, where the Republicans govern but face PL opponents in the electoral races.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Eduardo de 'vassalo' de Trump após Green Card: 'Talvez arrume emprego de faxineiro na Casa Branca'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, criticized Eduardo Bolsonaro after the latter received a U.S. Green Card, calling him a 'vassal' of Trump and suggesting he might get a job as a janitor at the White House. The remarks were made during an event in Cuiabá and shared on social media. Renan moved up his party convention due to alleged threats from criminal factions.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Com dificuldades para atrair centrão, Flávio Bolsonaro mobiliza ala mais radical
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to attract centrist parties and arrives at the PL convention without a defined running mate, relying on mobilizing his radical base. Despite remaining competitive in polls, he trails Lula, particularly due to weaker support among women and centrist voters. Two-thirds of his supporters say they would switch candidates if a more viable alternative to defeat Lula emerged.

item.title: PT rebate Flávio com preços do fim do governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT responded to Flávio Bolsonaro with a video comparing 2026 prices to those of 2022, the final year of Jair Bolsonaro’s government, rejecting the senator’s comparison with 2019. The piece highlights significant price increases for rice, beef, diapers, and picanha, accusing the senator of lying and stating that 'everyone remembers Bolsonaro’s high prices'.

item.title: A má impressão que Flávio deixou no Republicanos ao cortejar Daniella Marques para vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is attempting to secure an alliance with the Republicans party to have Daniella Marques as his vice-presidential candidate, after the deadline for party switches passed. Republicans view the move skeptically, believing Marques’ last-minute affiliation was a tactic to force the coalition. Despite Tereza Cristina’s rejection and lack of support from the União-PP federation, Flavio continues pushing for meetings with party leaders to gain electoral airtime and legitimacy.

item.title: Caos no transporte: falhas nas linhas da Trivia Trens deixam passageiros nos trilhos em São Paulo
item.description: Trivia Trens, the new operator of CPTM lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira, and 13-Jade, faced an energy supply failure on Thursday morning, halting train service between Brás and Engenheiro Goulart stations and leaving passengers on the tracks. The incident occurred just three days after the company took over operations, adding to at least six operational failures recorded in the first two days, including delays and temporary interruptions. Passengers reported overcrowding, lack of information, and increased waiting times, while the fire department responded to a train fire in the Brás area, drawing criticism toward Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ administration.

item.title: Flávio tira a fantasia de "moderado" e oficializa que é tal pai, tal filho
item.description: On the Noblat program, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro abandoned the image of a moderate candidate and fully embraced his father Jair Bolsonaro’s coup-oriented rhetoric, spreading lies about electronic voting machines and calling for international observers to prepare for rejecting the 2026 election results. Journalists Ricardo and Guga Noblat condemned this as a tactical error that mirrors the 2022 conduct which led to Jair Bolsonaro’s ineligibility, calling it desperate, damaging to Brazil’s reputation, and an attempt to win through backroom maneuvers.

item.title: Instituto Marielle Franco lança agenda com propostas a candidatos em defesa da democracia
item.description: On July 27, 2026, the Marielle Franco Institute launched an agenda presenting proposals for candidates, mandates, and social movements aimed at strengthening democracy and addressing inequalities in Brazil. The initiative seeks to influence electoral platforms with measures focused on social justice, human rights, and popular participation.

item.title: A falta de convicção do eleitorado de Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll shows 67% of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) voters would consider changing their vote if a more competitive candidate emerged, compared to just 27% of Lula's (PT) voters. Lula leads the first round with 40% voting intention, followed by Bolsonaro at 33%, while a potential runoff shows a technical tie (45% to 42%).

item.title: A estratégia de Lula para que novo tarifaço não o prejudique junto ao eleitorado
item.description: Lula and his allies say the Brazilian government is aligned to prevent the new U.S. tariffs from damaging his electoral image, noting Brazil’s trade deficit with the U.S. undermines Washington’s justification. They stress openness to negotiation and blame the tariff on Bolsonarist lobbying with Trump and Rubio, rejecting claims that the Planalto caused the decision.

item.title: Tarcísio reafirma confiança nas urnas: “Temos que sair dessa discussão”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas reaffirmed his trust in electronic voting machines, stating it's time to 'move past this discussion'. He made the remark after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, his political ally, renewed doubts about the electoral system and urged foreign diplomats to investigate. Tarcísio's statement aims to distance his administration from controversies over election integrity.

item.title: Ao vivo: Poder360 entrevista executivos e economistas na Expert XP 2026
item.description: Poder360 conducted live interviews with executives and economists during Expert XP 2026, a leading investment and economics event in Latin America held at São Paulo Expo from July 23-25. Interviewees included Jeferson Bittencourt (ASA), Rodrigo Sgavioli (XP), Gilberto Tomazoni (JBS), and other financial sector leaders, discussing Brazil's and global macroeconomic outlook, fiscal policy, artificial intelligence, sustainability, and economic prospects.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba o que os pré-candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 5ª
item.description: On Thursday (July 23, 2026), presidential pre-candidates are holding political articulation agendas, with Lula meeting ministers and the STJ president in Brasília; Caiado meeting mayors in Goiânia; Zema meeting supermarket representatives in São Paulo; and Renan Santos attending an open happy hour in Campo Grande. The schedules of other pre-candidates were not disclosed.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente 5ª feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has a focused agenda in Brasília on Thursday, July 23, 2026, with meetings at the Alvorada and Planalto Palaces. The highlight is a 3:00 p.m. meeting with the president and vice-president of the Superior Tribunal of Justice, Herman Benjamin and Luis Felipe Salomão. In the afternoon, Lula convenes eight ministers — including those from Casa Civil, Transportes, Mines and Energy, Environment, Regional Integration, Indigenous Peoples, and the General Secretariat — to discuss infrastructure, energy transition, and socio-environmental policies.

item.title: O relator da ação do PT contra Flávio Bolsonaro no TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, has been appointed as rapporteur of a representation filed by the PT, PCdoB, and PV against Flávio Bolsonaro and other PL allies over alleged coordinated disinformation about electronic voting machines. The action claims they decontextualized a U.S. document on Venezuela to falsely link Smartmatic to Brazilian elections, despite the TSE repeatedly denying any connection between the company and Brazil’s voting system. The parties are seeking removal of content, platform measures, and a fine of BRL 30,000 per target.
